correctness.rationale: For the exact displayed 4D polynomial ODE, q=0 forces p=s=r=0. With q≠0 the first two equations force r²=50 and p=qr/5. Then s=-52p/21 and the third equation is exactly 35q²−52q−1995=0; its two real nonzero roots times two signs of r yield exactly four nonzero equilibria. The origin Jacobian is diag(5,-10,-19/5,21/20), unstable index 2. Independent SymPy reconstruction of the full Jacobian characteristic polynomial at both r-signs, reduced modulo the equilibrium quadratic, gives the asserted quartic. Independently recomputed Routh B and C agree after exact algebraic reduction; using -7<q_±<9 yields signs +,+,-,+,-, so each nonzero equilibrium has three strict right-half-plane eigenvalues. The Routh array is nondegenerate, hence hyperbolic; no finite enumeration is used for completeness.
residual_risks: The conclusion concerns precisely the published rational parameter vector; no proof here for general coefficients.
Neither exact local eigenvalue counts nor equilibrium completeness imply an actual hyperchaotic attractor, basin structure or validity/failure of a controller.

value.rationale: The five-point equilibrium skeleton is a natural invariant of an actively studied four-dimensional hyperchaotic Chen–Lee benchmark, and its exact classification fills a concrete gap left by a same-ODE source that studies only the origin. The four omitted hyperbolic fixed points have unstable dimension three, versus two at the origin, a qualitative distinction relevant to local stable/unstable manifold dimensions and interpretations of basins and self-excitation. This is a motivated exact finite classification of a real benchmark system, not a parameter-renaming exercise or finite numerical sample. It does not claim a general-parameter theorem or invalidate synchronization by itself.
residual_risks: The scope is narrow: one parameter vector and local geometry, with no global phase portrait or attractor statement.
The benchmark source only asserts one specific equilibrium rather than explicit uniqueness; avoid overstating the source error.

limitations: 2009 source full-text comparison incomplete; institutional tool returned wrong document, not accepted as evidence
No theorem for other parameter values, chaotic attractor existence, basin topology or synchronization efficacy
Priority is best-of-knowledge, not established universal absence
